description: The College of Swords is the home of bards who combine martial prowess with their bardic magic. These bards are master duelists who weave magic into their swordplay.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with Medium armor, Martial melee weapons, and Scimitars.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose the Two-Weapon Fighting or Dueling fighting style. You gain the benefits of that style while wielding melee weapons.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one attack with a Blade Flourish. Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number to your AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Blade Flourish (Enhanced)
features.description: Your Blade Flourish becomes more powerful. You can add both your weapon's damage die and your Bardic Inspiration die to one attack roll.
